reference: User attachment: complete endowment formation scheme

assets.name: 01-classic
assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram. Reference image is a CONTENT AND LAYOUT REFERENCE, not a photo to copy literally. Create ONE COMPLETE, beautifully redesigned, sharp professional Russian-language infographic for the Polar State University endowment website. The entire diagram, ALL blocks, ALL arrows, ALL captions must appear together in this SINGLE landscape image, 16:9, at high resolution. Do not isolate any stage. No photographed screen, no blur, no perspective skew. Maintain generous clean margins. It must read as a whole educational scheme, similar organization to reference.
Exact Russian title at top: "Схема формирования целевого капитала".
Left column: heading "Жертвователи", illustration of multiple donors and golden coins. Under this column: "Пополнение ЦК:"; "30 дней (деньги / ценные бумаги)"; "60 дней (недвижимость)".
Three prominent arrows point RIGHT from donors to center. Between them caption "Договор пожертвования / оферта".
Center upper: illustration of people assembling complementary pieces, with checklist text "Отдельный банковский счёт" and "Совет по использованию ЦК".
Center middle heading: "Целевой капитал «НАУКА»". Under it an illustration of a capital reserve, with LARGE amount "3 млн руб.". Center bottom text: "1 год (1,5 млн руб.)" and "Продление сроком до 1 года".
Right lower: heading "Управляющая компания", illustration of professional asset managers, a chart and growth arrow. A prominent arrow points RIGHT from central capital to management, with caption "Договор Д.У.". Under management: "2 месяца"; "Передача имущества в управление УК"; "Утверждение финплана НКО".
Right upper: small investment income illustration and a prominent arrow points LEFT FROM management back toward center. Its label "Доход от ЦК". Under income return arrow caption "15 дней / срок по договору".
Hierarchy must make donation flow left-to-center, management flow center-to-right, and return income right-to-center unmistakable. All specified text must be complete, spelled correctly in Cyrillic, legible, balanced and nonoverlapping. These numeric conditions are faithfully copied from a supplied conceptual reference; do not invent additional financial figures. Avoid any extra brand logo, university management watermark or unrelated text. Visual style: elegant editorial infographic on pure white, clear navy typography, turquoise arrows, gold coin accents, restrained polished 3D ceramic miniature illustrations. Thin turquoise rule below title. Fine grid and generous whitespace. Adapt to navy #1d3754 and turquoise #2bc6c5 visual identity.
